artworks.title: A Garden of Many Lives
artworks.medium: Chinese ink and mineral color on paper
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original fine-art museum painting for a 3D vocabulary museum, square format, high resolution at least 1024 by 1024. Primary request: A richly observed garden flourishing with strikingly different kinds of plants together: curling ferns, broad lotus leaves and lotus blossoms beside water, fine bamboo, a gnarled flowering plum, spiky grasses and soft moss. Make their distinct forms beautifully legible as a single harmonious natural community. This expresses diversity: including many different types of things. Style and medium: Chinese ink and mineral color on paper. Create sophisticated gallery-quality art with composition, subtle material texture and luminous depth characteristic of this medium, never clip art. Cohesive restrained nature palette of sage green, ochre, muted indigo and warm paper tones. Full-bleed artwork covers the entire square canvas. No words, letters, numbers, lettering, labels, signatures, watermarks, borders, frames, museum wall, sticker outlines or white margins. Depict a real composed scene rather than an isolated icon. Request native 1536 by 1536 or larger if available.
